To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the water footprint of animal products (including feed and processing) is 10–20 times larger than that of plant-based products; (2) the water footprint per kilogram of protein is 10–50 times higher for animal products than for plant-based products; and (3) the water footprint is 10 times higher for dairy products and eggs than for beef and pork.

1) the water footprint of animal products is much larger per unit weight of product than that of plant products, 2) animal products contribute to about 60% of the total water footprint of the EU diet, and 3) the water footprint per capita of animal products is about three times higher than that of plant-based products.
